body:
## AJ — Operational-bottom derivation programme + scoped full-GMI establishment criterion

This is the canonical execution queue for the operational-bottom GMI programme. It supersedes any reading of `G0`, the previous state carrier, grammar, or finite axiom core as the ultimate bottom. Earlier results remain valid at their earned scopes.

```text
FOUNDATION / PHYSICAL-LAW ASSUMPTIONS
        ↓
ADMISSIBLE COMPOSABLE PROCESSES
        ↓
OPERATIONAL TESTS / CONTEXTUAL EQUIVALENCE
        ↓
DISTINGUISHABLE POSSIBILITIES / INFORMATION
        ↓
STABLE PROCESS ORGANIZATIONS
        ↓
MACHINES / MACHINE POSSIBILITY SPACE
        ↓
DEVELOPMENT / REACHABILITY
        ↓
REQUIREMENT-RELATIVE DISTINCTIONS
        ↓
CAPABILITY RESPONSE
        ↓
MI SPECIES / MORPHOLOGY
        ↓
DATA/TASK/RESOURCE-CONDITIONED SELECTION
```

Scientific rule: a checked box means the row has an evidence package merged to `main` at an explicit claim ceiling. A checked AJ row does **not** imply later AJ rows or `COMPLETE_GMI`.

### AJ0 — Correct the foundation claim ceiling — ✅ PR #911

Claim ceiling: `AJ0_FOUNDATION_SCOPE_AND_ANTI_PROMOTION_CONTRACT_AT_REGISTERED_FLAGSHIP_SCOPE`.

- [x] Re-label existing `G0` as a proved architecture-uncommitted grammar/presentation layer, not the ultimate substrate.
- [x] Re-label the finite axiom core as a satisfiable registered object-level core, not the absolute mathematical bottom.
- [x] Re-label `state carrier X` as a valid higher-level realization object whose primitiveness is under audit.
- [x] Preserve earlier theorem/evidence packages unchanged at their earned scopes.
- [x] Add `FOUNDATION_LAYER` / forbidden-promotion discipline to the registered flagship results.

### AJ1 — Define the operational bottom without intelligence-specific primitives — ✅ PR #912

Registered finite process frame:

`O_S=(Obj,Proc,∘,⊗,I,id,Adm_S,Obs_S)`.

Claim ceiling: `AJ1_TYPED_OPERATIONAL_PROCESS_FRAME_AT_FINITE_REGISTERED_SCOPE`.

- [x] Define the minimum typed process structure required for the finite GMI microscopes.
- [x] Compare category/process-theoretic, operational-probabilistic, relational, transition-system, coalgebraic and constructor-theoretic formulations.
- [x] Identify shared structure versus presentation-specific structure.
- [x] Include deterministic, nondeterministic relational and non-Dirac stochastic witnesses rather than assuming deterministic functions.
- [x] Make admissibility explicitly substrate/law-relative through `S` / `Adm_S`.
- [x] Forbid `ABSOLUTE_PROCESS_ONTOLOGY_PROVEN`.

Evidence includes 64 deterministic associativity cases, 4,096 relational associativity triples, relational/stochastic interchange, nondeterministic/stochastic witnesses, typed-mismatch hostile, substrate-admissibility twin and relative-irredundancy audit.

### AJ2 — Derive state, effect, test and operational equivalence from process roles — ✅ PR #914

`state/preparation: I -> A`, `effect/test: A -> I`.

Claim ceiling: `AJ2_OPERATIONAL_EQUIVALENCE_AND_STATE_RECONSTRUCTION_AT_FINITE_REGISTERED_TEST_SCOPE`.

- [x] Formalize state/effect roles at finite registered scope.
- [x] Define operational/contextual equivalence by equality under all registered admissible tests.
- [x] Prove equivalence-relation and quotient properties at finite scope.
- [x] Construct syntactically different but operationally equivalent hostiles.
- [x] Construct separating tests for every non-equivalent registered pair.
- [x] Parent-subtract contextual/observational equivalence, bisimulation/trace/coalgebraic and GPT-style operational equivalence.
- [x] Reconstruct a conventional state representation from response-signature equivalence classes at the registered scope.

Evidence: exhaustive 19,683 three-preparation/three-test response worlds; 56,862 separated pairs; two independent quotient constructions; restricted-test-family hostile prevents universalization.

### AJ3 — Derive distinguishability and information rather than assume a bit primitive — ✅ PR #915

Claim ceiling: `AJ3_DISTINGUISHABILITY_RESOURCE_ACCESS_AND_DECISION_RELEVANCE_AT_FINITE_REGISTERED_SCOPE`.

- [x] Formalize exact operational distinguishability and a quantitative total-variation separation measure.
- [x] Record the boundary that naive epsilon-indistinguishability is generally non-transitive and must not be silently quotiented.
- [x] Separate physical distinguishability, resource-accessible distinguishability and decision-relevant distinguishability.
- [x] Introduce finite information values only after probability/prior/outcome semantics are registered; bits are not base ontology.
- [x] Parent-subtract hypothesis testing/statistical decision theory, information theory, GPT operational distinguishability and Blackwell/Le Cam; connect to existing decision-sufficiency results without reifying the quotient inside the machine.

Evidence: all 81 two-preparation/two-test worlds, low-resource hiding hostiles, constant-utility irrelevance worlds, exact `(1+TV)/2` equal-prior binary discrimination law, and epsilon non-transitivity hostile.

### AJ4 — Derive machines as stable/composed process organizations — ✅ PR #923

Claim ceiling: `AJ4_FINITE_PROCESS_ORGANIZATION_AND_MACHINE_SPACE_AT_REGISTERED_BINARY_SCOPE`.

- [x] Define a finite process-organization object with interface, explicit wiring, optional substrate-admitted persistence/feedback and raw resource accounting.
- [x] Derive finite combinational circuits, finite-state/Mealy organizations and a bounded register-control organization as special cases.
- [x] Derive recurrence/feedback, memory-like persistence and conditional routing from process composition; feedback requires an admitted delay/persistence channel.
- [x] Define a complete frozen finite machine space `M_B(O,S)`.
- [x] Quotient operational duplicates at a declared protected I/O scope.
- [x] Keep `process possible`, `organization expressible`, `machine realizable`, `reachable` and `selected` machine-distinct.

Evidence: complete 260-organization Boolean universe; all 33,670 unordered pairs checked by reachable product-state all-word equivalence; 1,624 equivalent pairs collapsing to 148 operational classes; MUX, delay-memory, recurrence and bounded-register witnesses.

### AJ5 — Derive `G0` and later grammars from the operational bottom — ✅ PR #925

Claim ceiling: `AJ5_G0_COMPILED_FROM_LOWER_PROCESS_ROLES_AT_REGISTERED_BOUNDED_SCOPE`.

- [x] Compile `READ`, `EMIT`, register mutation, branching and termination from lower process/interface roles.
- [x] Classify every current G0 instruction: `READ/EMIT/INC/DECJZ = DERIVED`; `HALT = PRESENTATION_ONLY` at this scope.
- [x] Prove semantic preservation and charge bounded code/time/space/precision overhead.
- [x] Repeat through a materially different declarative relational lower presentation.
- [x] Identify which higher GMI results transport and which are presentation-relative.

Evidence: exact parent G0 blob pin; 121 two-label programs × 4 inputs = 484 parent-vs-lower executions, zero semantic failures and independently reproduced 9,003 micro-ops; <=5 micro-ops per G0 step/instruction; 99-row alternate relational presentation with zero disagreement. Behavioral/compiler theorems transport by refinement; G0 instruction minimality, description length and search geometry do not automatically transport.

### AJ6 — Place HST/HSG at the developmental layer — ✅ PR #928

Claim ceiling: `AJ6_HST_AS_DEVELOPMENT_OVER_PROCESS_ORGANIZATIONS_AT_REGISTERED_SCOPE`.

- [x] Construct the **contextual lift** `iota_chi(M_t)=Sigma_t`; prove that `M_t` alone does not uniquely determine `Sigma_t`.
- [x] Define development as higher-order transformation over process organizations/presentations/search state under the #233 HST object `Sigma=(L,Q,H,E,R,V,C)`.
- [x] Re-express inherited capital, operator invention, representation change, library formation, search-law change and recursive grammar growth over the lower GEN layer.
- [x] Preserve HST optional-inheritance, representation, information, transfer/evolvability and meta-NFL/Rice/halting/Goedel/Blum boundaries at their exact scopes.
- [x] Expose new lower-layer assumptions: presentation/compiler cost, verifier-access limits, endogenous/exogenous provenance, and substrate-change boundaries.

Evidence: 32 finite developmental worlds; 51 same-current/same-current-capability pairs with different best reachable future capability; silent substrate-law and constitution mutation fail closed.

### AJ7 — Keep requirements/value as an independent branch — ✅ PR #929

Claim ceiling: `AJ7_OBJECTIVE_UNDERDETERMINATION_AND_SOURCE_PROVENANCE_AT_REGISTERED_FINITE_SCOPE`.

- [x] Formalize objective-source provenance separately from machine/process provenance.
- [x] Prove an objective-underdetermination no-go: identical dynamics support incompatible requirement/reward orderings.
- [x] Parent-subtract IRL/reward-identifiability and policy-invariance results.
- [x] Distinguish distal viability/selection pressure, internal reward/drive, external specification and social/institutional constraints from effective downstream `Q`.
- [x] Forbid deriving a unique normative objective from world dynamics alone without additional premises.

Evidence: one identical self-loop dynamics with nine finite reward functions; three distinct optimal-action sets and nine disjoint-optimum reward pairs; observed actions remain compatible with multiple rewards; same effective binary requirement can have four registered provenance classes.

### AJ8 — Define where intelligence first appears — ✅ boundary result, PR #930

Claim ceiling: `AJ8_NEGATIVE_CONTROLS_AND_FIXED_VS_DEVELOPMENTAL_CAPABILITY_BOUNDARY_AT_REGISTERED_FINITE_SCOPE`.

- [x] Construct fixed lookup, fixed calculator, universal-interpreter, random-dynamics and passive-memory controls on one lower substrate.
- [x] Identify which candidate conditions each control satisfies/fails.
- [x] Preserve low-current/high-developmental and high-current/low-adaptation cases.
- [x] Separate information acquisition from computational unfolding/accessibility gain.
- [x] Separate entropy/novelty from target information and target-aligned capability.
- [x] Determine that development is **not necessary for narrow scoped fixed control capability**; register fixed-control and developmental-capability as separate axes/classes.
- [x] Do **not** freeze a universal intelligence definition; strongest-parent comparison remains binding for later flagship wording.

Exact boundaries: passive memory can preserve without exploit; fair random output has 1 bit entropy but 0 target mutual information; a finite interpreter solves all four tasks only when the correct external program is supplied; fixed lookup can be perfect without development; computational access can improve capability with zero new external target information.

### AJ9 — Blind derivation of all registered known MI families — OPEN

Known literature is evidence used to infer laws; it must not become hidden architecture input at derivation time.

For each registered family `K_i`:

`L^-i -> T^-i -> BlindDerive(T^-i, environment, requirements, resources)`.

- [x] Freeze the full registered known-family benchmark before family holdouts. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj9a-known-family-benchmark-v1` the 11-family registry was committed alone at freeze commit `aec01b0e`, pinned by Git blob `6b9ac3095c90d74e2717671a70ad7cc18955310c`, with role POSTHOC_ADJUDICATOR_ONLY and generator/search/evaluator access false; every later holdout receipt (aj9b-aj9h) re-asserts that same blob, and each holdout's own freeze commit contains only FREEZE_V1.md + SEARCH_CONFIG_V1.json (verified with /usr/bin/git ls-tree at all five aj9b-aj9f freeze commits).
- [x] Include at minimum neural/feed-forward, recurrent/stateful, local/shared-transform, attention/dynamic-routing, symbolic/rewrite/search, probabilistic/Bayesian, planning/control, retrieval/memory, evolutionary/search, program-synthesis and self-modifying/developmental families where operationally definable. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj9a-known-family-benchmark-v1` all eleven asked families are registered K01-K11 under exactly those names: neural/feed-forward, recurrent/stateful, local/shared-transform, attention/dynamic-routing, symbolic/rewrite/search, probabilistic/Bayesian, planning/control, retrieval/memory, evolutionary/population search, program synthesis, self-modifying/developmental - each with >=3 required fingerprint clauses, >=3 near-neighbour exclusions, >=2 observation tests and parent anchors.
- [x] Remove architecture names, semantic macros, family-specific operators/cost bonuses and evaluator leakage for every holdout. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj9-holdout-source-audit-v1` AJ9A-1/AJ9A-2: all 21 blind artifacts of the seven holdouts `aj9b`–`aj9h` carry 0 violations against the eight forbidden classes quoted verbatim from the frozen holdout contract, with the whole search vocabulary derived from the registry pinned at blob `6b9ac309` (11 identifiers, 11 names, 27 name tokens, 35 fingerprint clauses, 33 exclusion clauses, 24 observation clauses, 25 parent anchors); the absence is searched rather than empty — the same scanner returns 237 hits on the 20 post-hoc artifacts where family vocabulary is permitted, and 8 of 8 planted positives are detected, one per forbidden class, a validation that caught a real recall defect before this row was claimed.
- [x] Recover each family using post-hoc structural/behavioral equivalence criteria defined independently of search labels. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj9h-k07-k11-blind-recovery-v1` all 11 registered families reach terminal RECOVERED against fingerprints frozen in aj9a before any search, with adjudication run only after the blind outcome (`adjudication_started_after_blind_outcome: true` in every posthoc receipt); re-run on laptop-billy, aj9b-aj9h all exit 0 with `posthoc_terminal: RECOVERED`.
- [x] Require at least two materially different presentations and search procedures for flagship families. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj9h-k07-k11-blind-recovery-v1` the flagship robustness clause is frozen in the holdout contract and met by every family: K01-K06 receipts each carry `presentations: 2` and `searches: 2` (e.g. K01 TREE_AST vs POSTFIX_STACK_ENCODING under size-layered enumeration vs semantic cost closure, both first exact at operation cost 7), and K07-K11 carry `new_holdouts_two_materially_different_routes_each: true`.
- [x] Require explicit failure terminals rather than forcing a family match. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj9a-known-family-benchmark-v1` the frozen contract defines `NOT_RECOVERED_AT_SCOPE` as 'registered search/evidence budget ended without a candidate satisfying the frozen fingerprint; must be preserved as a scientific result', and the aj9h freeze repeats it as binding ('Failure is allowed and must return NOT_RECOVERED_AT_SCOPE'), so no run may force a family match.
- [x] Distinguish `COMPILED`, `RECOVERED`, `PREDICTED_SELECTED` and `NOT_RECOVERED_AT_SCOPE`. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj9a-known-family-benchmark-v1` all four terminals are separately defined with non-overlapping semantics (COMPILED = deliberately constructed, not blind recovery; RECOVERED = family-hidden search passes the frozen fingerprint; PREDICTED_SELECTED = pressure/regime predicted before reveal, then recovered; NOT_RECOVERED_AT_SCOPE = budget exhausted) and `check_aj9h.py` asserts the terminal set has not drifted; every AJ9 receipt records `predicted_selected: NOT_CLAIMED`.

### AJ10 — Prospective discovery of unknown MI forms — OPEN

- [x] Maintain an explicit `UNKNOWN_MORPHOLOGY` channel. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj10-prospective-unknown-v1` the channel exists and is exercised: T232 receives `registered_taxonomy: UNKNOWN_MORPHOLOGY` with `registered_family: null` (`check_aj10.py` re-run on laptop-billy, exit 0).
- [x] Freeze theory, search rules, equivalence tests and novelty criteria before prospective runs. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj10-prospective-unknown-v1` FREEZE_V1.md freezes the generative substrate, both search procedures, the post-hoc taxonomy/novelty protocol (five steps), the five novelty levels and the five terminals; the held-out environment records `created_after_freeze_commit: cbd5522018c0c9e8900df27f7b821b51dda897f5`, so the run is prospective.
- [x] Generate candidates in held-out environments/resource regimes without known-family labels in the evaluator. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj10-prospective-unknown-v1` the held-out task H1 carries `family_labels_present: false` and `taxonomy_visible_to_search: false`, and the source audit returns `blind_source_forbidden_hits: []`.
- [x] Evaluate capability/resource/developmental profiles before taxonomy matching. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj10-prospective-unknown-v1` `capability_evaluated_before_taxonomy: true`, with capability (8/8 protected cases exact), raw two-coordinate resource vectors and developmental profile (FIXED) committed for both candidates before the registry is read.
- [x] Run strongest-parent reduction only after generation/evaluation. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj10-prospective-unknown-v1` `strongest_parent_reduction_ran_after_generation_and_evaluation: true` and `taxonomy_ran_after_pre_taxonomy_evaluation: true`; the reduction then maps T232 to a classical finite truth/lookup table and E4 to finite program synthesis.
- [x] Require independent replication of a claimed novel form. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj10-prospective-unknown-v1` the frozen protocol requires it - 'A claimed novel form would require an independent replication' - and the receipt records `novel_replication_policy: REQUIRED_IF_NOVEL; not triggered because no novel form is claimed`, with `NOVEL_MI_DISCOVERED` in forbidden_promotions.
- [x] Distinguish novel implementation, morphology/architecture, algorithmic mechanism, computational class and capability profile. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj10-prospective-unknown-v1` both candidates are scored separately on all five asked levels (implementation, morphology_architecture, algorithmic_mechanism, computational_class, capability_profile) - e.g. T232 is PARENT_REDUCED_KNOWN on morphology/mechanism/class but NOT_ESTABLISHED on implementation.
- [x] Preserve `UNKNOWN` when novelty cannot be established. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj10-prospective-unknown-v1` the frozen policy preserves the pre-taxonomy UNKNOWN record without retroactive rewriting, and the overall disposition is `CANNOT_IDENTIFY_UNIQUE_MORPHOLOGY_FROM_CAPABILITY_AND_RAW_PARETO_RESOURCES` rather than a forced novelty or family claim.

### AJ11 — Bounded completeness versus unbounded openness — OPEN

For frozen finite `O,S,B,E,Q,R,H,V`:

- [x] Enumerate all organizations where feasible. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` `check_aj11.py` enumerates all 260 registered organizations (4 stateless plus all 256 one-bit feedback step tables) with `assert len(cs)==260`; re-run on laptop-billy, exit 0.
- [x] Collapse operational/specification duplicates. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` operational duplicates are collapsed by exact reachable-product all-word equivalence over 33,670 pair checks (1,624 equivalent pairs), giving 148 classes: 144 singletons and four 29-member classes.
- [x] Construct the complete bounded capability/development atlas. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` the complete atlas has one row per presentation carrying operational class, exact five-coordinate capability vector, raw (state_cells, truth_rows) resources and developmental distance; all 260 are reachable from seed S00 with max shortest distance 7, and the canonical compact JSON SHA-256 `09a99f29d2d349d7f28855d3a32776667c65cd1a707ea89129fd77c3328a16ed` reproduced exactly on laptop-billy.
- [x] Prove exact Pareto/preference frontiers under frozen conditions. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` the exact Pareto frontier under the seven-coordinate partial order (five task-failure coordinates + state_cells + truth_rows, no scalarization) is [M000, M001, M002, M043, M169], asserted as `front==[0,1,2,43,169]` and reproduced on laptop-billy.
- [x] Permit `COMPLETE_GMI_ATLAS_AT_BOUND_B` only with certified enumeration/quotient/evaluation completeness. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` the terminal is gated: `COMPLETE_GMI_ATLAS_AT_BOUND_B` is emitted only after the checker's completeness assertions all pass (260 enumerated, 148 classes, 33,670 pair checks, 1,624 equivalent pairs, capability constant within every class, canonical digest match and exact frontier); any drift aborts before the receipt is written.

For unbounded/universal scope:

- [x] Preserve syntax/enumerability versus semantic-decidability distinction. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` `syntax_programs: EFFECTIVELY_ENUMERABLE_UNDER_REGISTERED_FINITE_ALPHABET` is held apart from `semantic_equivalence: UNDECIDABLE_IN_GENERAL_AT_TURING_COMPLETE_SCOPE`, with THEORY.md giving the reason a terminating semantic catalogue would decide program equivalence.
- [x] Preserve Rice/halting/equivalence barriers where applicable. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` `nontrivial_semantic_properties: RICE_BOUNDARY_APPLIES_AT_STANDARD_SCOPE` and THEORY.md preserves both the program-equivalence undecidability and Rice barriers as parent mathematics rather than displacing them.
- [x] Require open-ended generativity, blind recovery, prospective prediction and `UNKNOWN` instead of a terminating complete semantic catalogue. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` the required policy is recorded as `OPEN_GENERATIVITY_PLUS_BLIND_RECOVERY_PLUS_PROSPECTIVE_UNKNOWN_NOT_TERMINATING_SEMANTIC_CATALOGUE`, itemised in THEORY.md as open-ended generativity, explicit undecidability/unknown terminals, AJ9 blind known-family recovery, AJ10 prospective UNKNOWN discovery and scoped prediction/replication.
- [x] Forbid `ALL_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCES_COMPLETELY_CLASSIFIED` at unbounded standard-computation scope. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj11-bounded-completeness-v1` `forbidden_terminal: ALL_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCES_COMPLETELY_CLASSIFIED`, with the bounded terminal explicitly restricted to the frozen finite scope in README.md and THEORY.md.

### AJ12 — Foundation and physical-substrate relativity — OPEN

- [x] Tag assumptions as `MATHEMATICAL_FOUNDATION`, `LOGIC/METATHEORY`, `PHYSICAL_SUBSTRATE_LAW`, `RESOURCE_MODEL`, or `VALUE/REQUIREMENT_INPUT`. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj12-foundation-substrate-relativity-v1` all five asked classes are used as the tag vocabulary: finite_carriers_and_extensional_equality=MATHEMATICAL_FOUNDATION, classical_decidable_finite_reasoning=LOGIC/METATHEORY, which_processes_are_admitted=PHYSICAL_SUBSTRATE_LAW, unit_and_vector_costs=RESOURCE_MODEL, protected_task_or_utility=VALUE/REQUIREMENT_INPUT (`check_aj12.py` re-run on laptop-billy, exit 0).
- [x] Re-express a compact GMI core under at least two materially different foundations/formalization styles where practical. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj12-foundation-substrate-relativity-v1` the compact core (carrier B={0,1}, four unary transformations, identity/composition closure, exact observation, operational quotient) is expressed twice - `FINITE_SET_RELATION_STYLE` (graph relations, relational composition) and `EXPLICIT_TYPED_ALGEBRAIC_PROCESS_STYLE` (typed records, tuple substitution) - under an explicit bijection frozen before the run.
- [x] Test theorem invariance, not merely notation translation. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj12-foundation-substrate-relativity-v1` invariance is tested at theorem level, not notation: all 16 ordered compositions agree across styles, identity laws agree, and three preparations under two registered tests give identical response signatures and the identical operational quotient [[p0,p2],[p1]].
- [x] Compare standard effective computation with registered alternative mathematical substrates/models; charge oracle/advice/precision/nonuniform information explicitly. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj12-foundation-substrate-relativity-v1` standard effective computation is the registered baseline and two alternative regimes are charged explicitly: an oracle/advice stream yielding bits [1,0,1,1] tagged `IMPORTED_ORACLE_OR_ADVICE_POWER`, and an exact real parameter `62/81` whose ternary digits recover the same four bits tagged `IMPORTED_EXACT_PRECISION_ADVICE`.
- [x] Keep physical hypercomputation empirical/open absent reproducible evidence. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj12-foundation-substrate-relativity-v1` `physical_hypercomputation: EMPIRICAL_OPEN__NO_REPRODUCIBLE_EVIDENCE_REGISTERED_HERE`, made mandatory by the freeze and backed by `PHYSICAL_HYPERCOMPUTATION_PROVED` / `SUPER_TURING_POWER_FROM_NOTHING` in forbidden_promotions.
- [x] Preserve Goedel/Tarski/meta-language limits; no all-truth self-justifying final foundation. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj12-foundation-substrate-relativity-v1` `metatheory_boundaries: [GODEL_INCOMPLETENESS_SCOPE_PRESERVED, TARSKI_OBJECT_LANGUAGE_METALANGUAGE_BOUNDARY_PRESERVED]`, with `SELF_JUSTIFYING_ALL_TRUTH_FOUNDATION` and `UNIQUE_TRUE_FOUNDATION_PROVED` in forbidden_promotions.

### AJ13 — Recursive descent stopping rule — OPEN

Stop the operational descent only when all remaining assumptions satisfy:

```text
1. explicitly foundation/physics/value tagged;
2. no MI-specific mechanism remains in the base;
3. removing each remaining operational primitive has a demonstrated loss/boundary;
4. higher GMI results survive materially different equivalent presentations;
5. no lower parent formalism subsumes the claimed novelty without acknowledgement;
6. further descent concerns logic/mathematics/physical-law/metaphysics rather than a hidden MI mechanism.
```

- [x] Establish `FOUNDATION_RELATIVE_GMI_CORE_STABLE_AT_REGISTERED_SCOPE` under this rule. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj13-stopping-rule-v1` `terminal: FOUNDATION_RELATIVE_GMI_CORE_STABLE_AT_REGISTERED_SCOPE` with `criteria_satisfied: 6` against the six conjuncts the row's code block states, consuming AJ1's loss witnesses and AJ5/AJ12 presentation-invariance evidence, and rejecting all six one-condition hostiles (`hostile_cases_rejected: 6`); `check_aj13.py` re-run on laptop-billy, exit 0.
- [x] Forbid `ABSOLUTE_BOTTOM_OF_MATHEMATICS_OR_REALITY_PROVEN`. — ✅ `gmi-833-aj13-stopping-rule-v1` `forbidden_terminal: ABSOLUTE_BOTTOM_OF_MATHEMATICS_OR_REALITY_PROVEN`, enforced rather than merely declared: the `absolute_promotion` hostile is rejected with reason `ABSOLUTE_BOTTOM_PROMOTION_FORBIDDEN`.

### AJ14 — Scoped “full theory of machine intelligence” establishment criterion — OPEN

A full GMI theory at declared scope requires all of:

```text
FOUNDATION:
  operational bottom explicit, parent-audited and presentation-robust.
GENERATION:
  machines/families arise as organizations rather than named primitives.
DEVELOPMENT:
  reachability and developmental response are connected to the lower GEN layer.
RELEVANCE/CAPABILITY:
  task-relevant distinctions and capability/resource response are explicit.
SELECTION:
  data/task/resource-conditioned selection is predictive rather than post-hoc.
RECOVERY:
  registered known MI families are blindly recovered under leave-family-out/no-smuggling controls.
DISCOVERY:
  frozen theory permits prospectively generated `UNKNOWN` forms and independent novelty review.
BOUNDARIES:
  computability, identifiability, learning, verification, resource and substrate limits are mapped.
EVIDENCE:
  flagship laws survive bounded exact microscopes, hostile review, prospective tests, independent replication and real-system validation where required.
```

Target terminal hierarchy (not yet earned):

```text
GMI_CORE_FORMALIZED_AT_SCOPE
GMI_BOUNDED_ATLAS_COMPLETE_AT_SCOPE
GMI_KNOWN_FAMILIES_BLINDLY_RECOVERED_AT_SCOPE
GMI_SELECTION_LAWS_PROSPECTIVELY_VALIDATED_AT_SCOPE
GMI_NOVEL_FORM_DISCOVERY_REPLICATED_AT_SCOPE
FULL_GMI_THEORY_SUPPORTED_AT_DECLARED_SCOPE
```

Forbidden implications: `ALL_PHYSICALLY_POSSIBLE_INTELLIGENCES_KNOWN`, `UNIQUE_ABSOLUTE_MATHEMATICAL_FOUNDATION`, `UNIVERSAL_BEST_INTELLIGENCE`, `ALL_FUTURE_MI_FORMS_ENUMERATED`, `ALL_SEMANTIC_PROPERTIES_DECIDABLE`, `OBJECTIVES_DERIVED_FROM_PHYSICS_ALONE`, `COMPLETE_GMI_IN_ALL_CONCEIVABLE_PHYSICS`.

### AJ15 — Flagship end-to-end falsification experiment — OPEN

- [ ] Run end-to-end first on a bounded universe where every candidate can be enumerated.
- [ ] Hide at least one known architecture family from theory construction and evaluation labels.
- [ ] Require blind recovery or an honest failure terminal.
- [ ] Include ecology/resource regimes in which the held-out family is predicted *not* to appear.
- [ ] After bounded success, repeat at larger non-enumerable scales with independent search implementations.
- [ ] Require the same theory to permit both known-family recovery and non-known-family outputs.
- [ ] Treat failure as a direct falsifier of a strong seen/unseen derivation claim.
